status: 나그네새 수천 마리 · 겨울철새 수백 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 바닷가 항구, 앞바다, 하구, 갯벌, 바닷가 모래밭
summary: 봄가을 이동기에 수천 마리가 지나가고 수백 마리가 겨울을 나는 갈매기로, 섬의 항구와 고깃배 주변, 하구와 바닷가 모래밭에서 재갈매기 무리에 섞여 지내며 민물에는 잘 들어오지 않는다. 국내에 오는 무리는 대부분 시베리아 북부 타이미르반도 일대에서 번식하는 무리(taimyrensis)이고, 유럽 북부에서 번식하는 등이 아주 검은 무리는 드물게 기록된다. 9월 중순부터 오기 시작해 10월 중순에 가장 많고, 한겨울에는 줄었다가 2–3월에 다시 늘어난다.

art.subject: Lesser Black-backed Gull of the Taimyr form (Larus fuscus taimyrensis), the form behind most Korean records, adult in winter as seen on Korean coasts from November to March: white head with fine grey-brown streaks on the crown, around the eye and densest on the hindneck, kept into early spring; mantle and folded wings medium-dark grey, clearly darker than a Vega or Mongolian Gull's but paler than the slate-grey of Heuglin's Gull; white tertial crescent and white tips to the secondaries; black wingtip with small white mirrors and small white primary tips; underparts, rump and tail white. Bill yellow, deep at the gonys, with a red gonys spot that can spread onto the upper mandible; pale iris; red orbital ring; legs yellow.
art.pose: standing on a sandy beach among resting gulls, side view
art.scene: Korean coast in winter (January): a sandy beach and dark rocks at the waterline under a pale sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing: white head with fine grey-brown streaks densest on the hindneck, medium-dark grey back and wings, darker than a Vega Gull's, long black wingtips with small white spots projecting beyond the tail, yellow bill with a red gonys spot, yellow legs

adult in spring (March–April), head close-up in side view: white head with a few fine streaks left on the hindneck, pale iris, red orbital ring, deep yellow bill with a red gonys spot spreading slightly onto the upper mandible

adult in flight seen squarely from above, wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span and bent slightly at the wrist: medium-dark grey upperwing with a white trailing edge, black wingtips with small white mirrors, white head, body and square white tail
art.build: Large, long-winged gull of the Vega Gull size class but less bulky than a Mongolian Gull, much larger than a Black-tailed Gull. Fairly flat crown and strong neck; bill yellow, deep and thick-based, with a marked angle at the gonys. Legs medium length and fairly thick, yellow, brightest in spring and duller, sometimes flesh-tinged, in winter. At rest the long black primaries project well beyond the tail. In flight the medium-dark grey upperwing shows a white trailing edge and a black wingtip with small white mirrors; tail square and all white in adults.
art.basis: 형태: 국내외 종 설명 교차 확인(출처 목록) · tools/ART_RULES.md
avoid: Do not paint pink legs; this gull's legs are yellow (pink legs mark Vega Gull, Larus vegae).
Do not paint the back blackish or dark slate like Slaty-backed or Heuglin's Gull; it is a medium-dark grey only a few shades darker than a Vega Gull's.
Do not paint a pure white, unstreaked head on the winter adult; fine streaks stay on the hindneck into spring (Mongolian Gull is white-headed by then).
Do not paint a black tail band or a black-and-red bill tip (Black-tailed Gull).
